headline: Trump and Xi met in Shenzhen on Nov 19 for about an hour, then held the first US-China-Russia summit with Putin (#3124). China's account says Xi told Trump the US 'must keep doing the right thing' on Taiwan; the joint statement says 'there can be no winners in a nuclear war'. CBS says little concrete came of it.
China's readout says Trump said the US does not support Taiwan independence; Taiwan says that is untrue. No allowed outlet confirms what Trump said (#3124).
No US transit, arms notice, sanctions or export-control step against China was found this week; the $14 billion Taiwan arms package is still paused (#3064).
No new PLA drill, patrol, aircraft surge or coast-guard clash was found Nov 14-20; Russian bombers flew near Taiwan on Nov 17 and 19 (Russia, not logged here).
Small numbers: most options have only a handful of counted cases.
